export interface SimpleGitBase {
    add: (files: string | string[], callback?: types.SimpleGitTaskCallback<string>) => Response<string>
    cwd: { (directory: { path: string; root?: boolean; }, callback?: types.SimpleGitTaskCallback<string>): Response<string>; <path extends string>(directory: path, callback?: types.SimpleGitTaskCallback<path>): Response<path>; }
    hashObject: { (path: string, callback?: types.SimpleGitTaskCallback): Response<string>; (path: string, write?: boolean, callback?: types.SimpleGitTaskCallback): Response<string>; }
    init: { (bare: boolean, options?: types.TaskOptions, callback?: types.SimpleGitTaskCallback<resp.InitResult>): Response<resp.InitResult>; (bare: boolean, callback?: types.SimpleGitTaskCallback<resp.InitResult>): Response<resp.InitResult>; (options?: types.TaskOptions, callback?: types.SimpleGitTaskCallback<resp.InitResult>): Response<resp.InitResult>; (callback?: types.SimpleGitTaskCallback<resp.InitResult>): Response<resp.InitResult>; }
    merge: (options: types.TaskOptions, callback?: types.SimpleGitTaskCallback<resp.MergeResult>) => Response<resp.MergeResult>
    mergeFromTo: { <E extends GitError>(remote: string, branch: string, options?: types.TaskOptions, callback?: types.SimpleGitTaskCallback<resp.MergeResult, E>): Response<resp.MergeResult>; <E extends GitError>(remote: string, branch: string, callback?: types.SimpleGitTaskCallback<resp.MergeResult, E>): Response<resp.MergeResult>; }
    outputHandler: (handler: types.outputHandler | void) => SimpleGitBase
    push: { (remote?: string, branch?: string, options?: types.TaskOptions, callback?: types.SimpleGitTaskCallback<resp.PushResult>): Response<resp.PushResult>; (options?: types.TaskOptions, callback?: types.SimpleGitTaskCallback<resp.PushResult>): Response<resp.PushResult>; (callback?: types.SimpleGitTaskCallback<resp.PushResult>): Response<resp.PushResult>; }
    stash: { (options?: types.TaskOptions, callback?: types.SimpleGitTaskCallback<string>): Response<string>; (callback?: types.SimpleGitTaskCallback<string>): Response<string>; }
    status: { (options?: types.TaskOptions, callback?: types.SimpleGitTaskCallback<resp.StatusResult>): Response<resp.StatusResult>; (callback?: types.SimpleGitTaskCallback<resp.StatusResult>): Response<resp.StatusResult>; }
}
export interface SimpleGitFactory {
}
export interface SimpleGitOptions {
    abort: AbortSignal | undefined
    baseDir: string
    binary: string | [string] | [string, string] | undefined
    completion: { onClose?: boolean | number; onExit?: boolean | number; } | undefined
    config: string[]
    errors: ((error: Buffer | Error | undefined, result: Omit<GitExecutorResult, "rejection">) => Buffer | Error | undefined) | undefined
    maxConcurrentProcesses: number
    progress: ((data: SimpleGitProgressEvent) => void) | undefined
    spawnOptions: Pick<SpawnOptions, "uid" | "gid"> | undefined
    timeout: { block: number; stdErr?: boolean; stdOut?: boolean; } | undefined
    trimmed: boolean
    unsafe: Partial<VulnerabilityCategoryFlags & { allowUnsafeCustomBinary: boolean; }> | undefined
}
export interface SimpleGitProgressEvent {
    method: string
    processed: number
    progress: number
    stage: string
    total: number
}
export type SimpleGitTaskCallback = SimpleGitTaskCallback<T, E>;
export interface StatusResult {
    ahead: number
    behind: number
    conflicted: string[]
    created: string[]
    current: string | null
    deleted: string[]
    detached: boolean
    files: FileStatusResult[]
    ignored: string[] | undefined
    isClean: () => boolean
    modified: string[]
    not_added: string[]
    renamed: StatusResultRenamed[]
    staged: string[]
    tracking: string | null
}
export interface StatusResultRenamed {
    from: string
    to: string
}
export interface TagResult {
    all: string[]
    latest: string | undefined
}
export class TaskConfigurationError {
    cause: unknown
    message: string
    name: string
    stack: string | undefined
    task: SimpleGitTask<any> | undefined
}
export type TaskOptions = TaskOptions<O>;
export interface VersionResult {
    agent: string
    installed: boolean
    major: number
    minor: number
    patch: string | number
}
export const default: SimpleGitFactory;
export const gitP: SimpleGitFactory;
export function grepQueryBuilder: (...params: string[]) => GitGrepQuery;
export type outputHandler = outputHandler;
export function pathspec: (...paths: string[]) => string;
export const simpleGit: SimpleGitFactory;
